newsitem.title: INDIA: India says contracted 2.74 mln T wheat imports.
newsitem.headline: India says contracted 2.74 mln T wheat imports.

text.p: India's state-run State Trading Corp (STC) said on Friday it had contracted to import 2.74 million tonnes of wheat since December 1996.
"We have firmed up (import) contracts for a total of 2.74 million tonnes of wheat (since December 1996)," STC chairman B.K. Chaturvedi told reporters in the Indian capital.
He said the STC contracted 1.74 million tonnes for import in 1996/97 (April-March). In the last week of March, it contracted for another one million tonnes for arrival after August 1997.

Asked whether the government had authorised the import of the one million tonnes in addition to the two million tonnes already authorised in December 1996, Chaturvedi said, "Whatever has been done is under government authorisation."
Earlier on Friday a senior STC official said the company had so far contracted to import only 1.74 million tonnes since Decemeber 1996.
